defaultInput.content: A fictional contact sent a greeting.

requestAssumption: Wrap each materialized input in CheckRequestSchema with a fresh valid UUID. An authorised same-origin request is required before the input-validation result can be assessed.

prohibitedOutcomes: Consume an AI call for invalid input.
Present rejected input as a completed scam assessment.

cases.rationale: Whitespace is not a non-screenshot message.
A malformed optional sender field must not become an invented identity.
A screenshot input requires an actual image field.
Images may not accompany a message-mode input; decoding is not the reason for this schema rejection.
Call mode accepts a description; audio is not an implemented input mode.
Strict input schemas reject an attempted undeclared provider/model override.
Reject content beyond the declared character limit before any generation.
The privacy preference requires a Boolean; strings must not be silently coerced.
